name: Ellis Fabrics
old_description: Ellis Fabrics in Bentonville, Arkansas, offers a wide selection of quality, affordable upholstery and home décor fabrics and trims, as well as customer service that can’t be beat. We encourage you to come in, browse, and ask any questions you may have. We love to talk with our customers about their projects!
about:
Ellis Fabrics operates in Bentonville, Arkansas, as the retail arm of Joe Ellis Upholstery. Joe Ellis began upholstering in 2002, working with independent shops in Arkansas and Louisiana. He opened Joe Ellis Upholstery in 2008, and the business grew to a larger space within five years. In 2013, Ellis and his mother, Cheryl, added a fabric store to answer frequent customer requests for fabric sources. The company remains privately held, with Ellis as owner and his mother involved in the expansion.

The business runs two workrooms staffed by nine full-time professionals plus part-time help, producing custom upholstery for residential, commercial, and specialty markets. In addition to fabrication, Ellis Fabrics stocks a range of upholstery and home décor fabrics, trims, real and faux leather, outdoor fabrics, and specialty designer materials available for special order. A design center offers in-person consultation for fabric selection and durability guidance. The shop also provides pick-up and delivery service across Northwest Arkansas, Northeast Oklahoma, and Southwest Missouri.

Customers span residential clients, hospitality venues such as restaurants, bars, museums, and hotels, medical and fitness facilities, and RV or motorhome owners. Notable accounts include the Roark Group (design/fabrication), Onyx Coffee Lab (hospitality), Laura's Draperies & Blinds (window treatments), and various interior designers and architects across Arkansas and beyond.

The company emphasizes a full-service experience from consultation to finished piece, summarized by the tagline “If you can dream it, we can upholster it.” Clients cite swift communication, meticulous attention to detail, and the ability to meet tight timelines on highly custom projects as distinguishing factors.
